sv.title: Israel har inlett en ny offensiv i Gaza
sv.summary: Israel har inlett en ny offensiv i Gaza, rapporterar AFP. En AFP-journalist på plats uppger att israeliska stridsvagnar har intagit positioner öster om flyktinglägret Nuseirat.

en.title: Israel has launched a new offensive in Gaza
en.summary: Israel has launched a new offensive in Gaza, AFP reports. An AFP journalist on the scene says Israeli tanks have taken positions east of the Nuseirat refugee camp.
